interpretations.half_cell: x in [0, pitch/2], x=0 JFET centre; x_jfet = W_J/2 (W_J = full width)
interpretations.layout: gate end x_g = x_cs - 0.5 um (gate-source separation); source contact [x_cs, x_max]; x_cs = x_max - L_contact (central 3 um, comparison (a) LS 2 um)
interpretations.gate_over_source: gate overhangs the n+ source by L_ov = x_g - x_src0 (x_src0 = x_jfet + ch_len, ch_len calibrated to the electrical L_ch)
interpretations.channel_length: L_ch is the electrical (net-p surface) channel length of the rounded doping (r = 0.1 um, as in all earlier stages): ch_len between the 50 % points is calibrated per configuration. The literal mapping ch_len = L_ch is degenerate (the n+ tail removes the whole net-p surface at N_A,s = 2.5e17: 5 of 16 pre-run corners had no channel column) and is reported as scan item nominal_l_ch. This choice was made after the first DEV pre-run exposed that degeneracy.
interpretations.p_contact: no separate p+ region is modelled: a 0.06 um body-contact strip at the cell edge (bc_w 0.04, pad_w 0.02); modelled source contact = L_contact - 0.04 um
interpretations.L_c: Delta R_c uses the modelled n+ source contact length (central 2.96 um, (a) 1.96 um)
interpretations.comparison_a_assumptions: pitch 8 um with LS = 2 um read as source-contact length; gate geometry (0.5 um separation) copied from the fabricated cell; t_ox 50 nm; V_G 20 V; V_DS 0.1 V; CSL 0.3 um at 1e17; JFET 1e17; uniform body N_A; no substrate
interpretations.csl_thickness: t_csl = 0.3 um below the 0.6 um body (Fig. 1 depth); JFET column 1e17 over the body depth; drift 6 um at 1e16 below the CSL
interpretations.ionization_levels: acceptor ionization levels, hole mobility and V_FB at N_A,s; the retrograde N_A(y) enters only as doping (documented approximation)
interpretations.gate_material: V_FB of the existing model (n+ poly-Si gate work function); S07 gate material not used
interpretations.bias: V_GS = 20 V (top-curve label of Fig. 9); V_DS = 0.1 V (stage convention; S07 bias not stated); T = 300 K
interpretations.R_sub_central: R_sub central = 0.35 mOhm cm^2 (range midpoint; the spec gives only the range [0, 0.7])
interpretations.w_j_eff: W_J,eff changes x_jfet only; the drawn layout (x_g, x_cs, pitch) is fixed
interpretations.bracket: the 16 PDE corners (N_A,s, N_A,b, W_J,eff, L_ch) x 4 series corners (rho_c, R_sub) = 64 totals; the one-at-a-time points are corners of this set
interpretations.S07_arm: E_gate = q(N_dep + N_S)/eps_ox from the column state (N_dep at the column surface N_A), piecewise-linear Fig. 12 fit, constant outside 0.5..4 MV/cm; figure-read and approximate
interpretations.mu_const_scope: constant 20 cm^2/Vs on every channel edge (both nodes within d_ch of the interface, p-type surface columns); accumulation/bulk unchanged
interpretations.off_state: V_pt,es: smallest V_D with min n+ -> body barrier < 10 V_T (stage 20 method, level h); BV: dense avalanche cuts (26 columns) on level h, zero gate bias, no termination
interpretations.C2_definition: |R_total(h/4)/R_total(h/2) - 1| <= 3 % for both arms (the PDE-only change is also reported)
